posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Today on the Digital One Deck Dungeon Kickstarter we announced that Fanatic is making a cross-over appearance!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/handelabra/one-deck-dungeon-digital-tabletop-game/posts/2036496

She's an early stretch goal so we hope that Sentinels fans can get on board and unlock her. What do you think her heroic feat and skill will be? How would she fare against a glooping ooze, plague rat, or the Minotaur? I'm looking forward to finding out =)

posts.name: darkroydante
posts.cooked:
There's a joke here about XPW Fanatic being really good against Plague Rat, but I'm not clever enough to make it.

I feel like her heroic will be something in line with the Slayer- store a heroic die when you defeat a combat room. Her 2P skill will be Embolden, letting an ally re-roll a strength or an agility die. 

I'm excited to hit this stretch goal!

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Handelabra has been asked to treat One-Deck Fanatic as a Disparation variant, and specifically asked to incorporate aspects of all her existing variants into this one.  The Swaptober variants are also official Disparation canon, so if they wanted to include, say, the Naturalist, Handelabra would not just have the option of using the Swaptober version, but technically would have a mandate to do so.
